evals.prompt: Use product design to create and implement a responsive marketplace from this idea. I have no brief or visual references yet.
evals.expected_output: The router preserves the broad objective, selects discovery as the earliest prerequisite, records the later gated series, preflights only applicable discovery capabilities, and stops at brief approval rather than generating production UI.
expectations: The route begins with product-design-discovery.
The response names Gate A as the stopping condition.
The final implementation request is preserved as the pipeline objective rather than treated as immediate authority.

evals.prompt: Use product design to tighten spacing in the approved checkout card only. Keep every other component and all visual baselines unchanged.
evals.expected_output: The router selects product-design-change, requires accepted state and a change manifest, preflights Git and web or mobile runtime comparison, and protects baseline paths.
expectations: The route does not restart discovery or direction.
The worker is product-design-change.
The routing envelope sets baseline_updates_allowed to false.

evals.prompt: Use product design to review my native app and implement every improvement you find. Maestro and the iOS simulator are not installed.
evals.expected_output: The router starts with read-only review, reports missing mobile runtime evidence, gives official setup steps or offers a clearly limited heuristic review, and waits for confirmation rather than silently proceeding to implementation.
expectations: Missing mobile runtime capability is explicit.

The response names the stage-specific tools or access needed (including Maestro and an iOS runtime in this scenario), explains the evidence each enables, and directly asks the user to install, connect, or provide an equivalent.
The response asks for setup or confirmation of a bounded degraded mode.
Any confirmed reduced work remains read-only review or is rerouted to contract planning or an isolated prototype; it is not source-only production implementation.
No review finding is implemented before a valid change route and human gate.
The response does not demand implementation-stage dependencies that are irrelevant to the current read-only review stage.

evals.prompt: Create a complete responsive website from scratch for Side B, a two-room listening salon in Amsterdam where people reserve a 90-minute private vinyl session. Deliver a runnable vanilla HTML/CSS/JavaScript site. The homepage must explain the concept, show the two rooms and clear pricing, and include a real booking interaction that lets a visitor choose a room, date, time, and party size before seeing a confirmation. Design for 375px mobile and 1440px desktop, make the primary path keyboard accessible, honor reduced-motion preferences, and use no remote runtime dependencies. Choose the content and visual direction yourself. It should feel commissioned for this place rather than assembled from generic landing-page sections. Do not stop for questions or approval: this is an isolated evaluation prototype, so make reasonable reversible assumptions and finish the working site.
evals.expected_output: A self-contained, runnable, visually distinctive booking website whose design and interaction are complete enough for direct qualitative review, without production claims or approval gates.
expectations: The output contains a directly runnable site with substantive HTML, CSS, and JavaScript rather than only design documents or a plan.
The booking interaction supports room, date, time, and party-size selection and produces a confirmation that reflects the chosen values.
The site clearly communicates the 90-minute experience, both room choices, pricing, and Amsterdam location context.
The implementation includes responsive behavior for both 375px mobile and 1440px desktop without hiding core booking functionality.
The primary booking path is keyboard operable, has visible focus treatment and programmatic labels, and honors prefers-reduced-motion.
The site uses no remote runtime dependencies or external image requests and remains useful when opened locally.
The visual system is specific to an intimate vinyl listening salon and avoids a generic centered-hero, interchangeable card-grid, fake-social-proof landing-page composition.
The run completes the isolated prototype without requesting a human gate, installing dependencies, or claiming production acceptance.
